attempts.text:
**The window starts in a seven-column spine.** Columns 0 to 6, `ftsL` to `ilvI`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 96 to 100% of them, fewest at `cra` (96%), and hesitates most at `fruR`, 0.23 bits.

**A single fork follows at column 7**, where the model names 77% and hesitates 0.36 bits; its branch carries protein YabR in 64% of chromosomes. Then columns 8 to 13, `leuO` to `leuD`, [[leucine biosynthesis]], a spine carried by 92 to 96%, named 95 to 99.8%, with `leuO` the weakest at 95% and 0.66 bits. Column 14 is variable, `setA` in 61%, named 96%.

**The long middle spine runs from `sgrT` to `caiA`**, columns 15 to 44, carried by 92 to 96%, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 2% of calls. The model names 77 to 100% there, fewest at `djlA`, column 28, named 77% at 0.78 bits. Column 45 is variable, `caiB` in 90%, named 97%. Columns 46 to 60, `caiC` to `rpsT`, [[carnitine and carbamoyl phosphate metabolism]], are carried by 90 to 96%, named 93 to 99%, fewest at `fkpB` (93%).

**Hesitation peaks late.** Column 61, an IS1-like element transposase, is variable, in a region of plasticity in 6% of calls, named 79% at 0.81 bits, the most hesitant column. Columns 62 to 64, `nhaR` to `mokC`, are a spine in a region of plasticity in 11 to 23% of calls, named 82 to 90%. Column 65, a fork, is the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 25%, named 81%; its branch carries a transposase in 44% and a fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone in 23%.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 66 to 72, `dnaJ` to `tal`, are a spine in a region of plasticity in 7 to 24% of calls, named 82 to 98%, fewest at `dnaJ` (82%). Columns 73 to 79 mix fork and variable columns: `yaaJ` to `thrA` are variable, carried by 49 to 85%, and column 79, `thrL`, is a fork in 37%. The model names 98 to 99% there. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.80 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 74% against 96%.

label: ftsL
facts:
WINDOW: the ftsL window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ftsL, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,630 to 3,709 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ftsL once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,607 calls, named 99%, 0.15 bits; shell 3,479 calls, named 60%, 0.99 bits; cloud 114 calls, named 1%, 2.10 bits. Outside an RGP 41,931 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 1,269 calls, named 74%, 0.80 bits. Columns: 68 spine, 3 fork, 9 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.80 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 96%); 1,269 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 61 ("IS1-like element transposase") 0.81 bits, RGP 6%; column 28 (djlA) 0.78 bits, RGP 0%; column 62 (nhaR) 0.67 bits, RGP 11%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 65 (fork), RGP 25%; the least: columns 0-6 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-6 (7 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ftsL, rsmH, mraZ, cra, fruR, ilvN "acetolactate synthase small subunit", ilvI. named 96-100% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 3 (cra), named 96%; most hesitant at column 4 (fruR), 0.23 bits.
2. column 7 fork: RGP 0%. named 77%; 0.36 bits.
   7: "protein YabR" S 64%; also "hypothetical protein" S 14%
3. columns 8-13 (6 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: leuO, leuL, leuA, leuB, leuC "3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large…", leuD. named 95-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 8 (leuO), named 95%, 0.66 bits.
4. column 14 variable: RGP 0%. named 96%; 0.41 bits.
   14: setA S 61%
5. columns 15-44 (30 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0-2%. Genes: sgrT "glucose uptake inhibitor SgrT", sgrR, thiB, thiP, thiQ "thiamine ABC transporter ATP-bindin…", yabI "DedA family protein", araC, araB, araA, araD "class II aldolase/adducin family pr…", polB, rapA, rluA, djlA, lptD, surA, pdxA, rsmA, apaG, apaH "bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase…", folA, kefC, kefF "NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductase", yaaU "MFS transporter", fixX, fixC, fixB, fixA "putative electron transfer flavopro…", caiT "L-carnitine/gamma-butyrobetaine ant…", caiA. named 77-100% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 28 (djlA), named 77%, 0.78 bits.
6. column 45 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 97%; 0.29 bits.
   45: caiB P 90%
7. columns 46-60 (15 columns) spine: share 90-96%, all P, RGP 0.4-4%. Genes: caiC, caiD, caiE, caiF, carB, carA "carbamoyl phosphate synthase small…", dapB, rihC, ispH, fkpB, lspA, ileS, ribF, yaaY "DUF2575 family protein", rpsT. named 93-99% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 55 (fkpB), named 93%; most hesitant at column 60 (rpsT), 0.27 bits.
8. column 61 variable: RGP 6%. named 79%; 0.81 bits.
   61: "IS1-like element transposase" S 26%
9. columns 62-64 (3 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 11-23%. Genes: nhaR, nhaA "Na+/H+ antiporter NhaA", mokC. named 82-90% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 64 (mokC), named 82%; most hesitant at column 62 (nhaR), 0.67 bits.
10. column 65 fork: RGP 25%. named 81%; 0.50 bits.
   65: "transposase" S 44%; also "fimbria/pilus periplasmic chaperone" S 23%
11. columns 66-72 (7 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 7-24%. Genes: dnaJ, dnaK "molecular chaperone DnaK", yaaI "DUF2541 family protein", msyB, satP, mog, tal. named 82-98% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 66 (dnaJ), named 82%, 0.47 bits.
12. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-6%. named 98-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 73, named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.18 bits (column 74).
   columns 73-78 variable, share 49-85%, all P: yaaJ "alanine:cation symporter family pro…" 85%, yaaA "peroxide stress protein YaaA" 83%, yaaX "DUF2502 domain-containing protein" 76%, thrC 67%, thrB 58%, thrA 49%
   79 fork: thrL P 37% "thr operon leader peptide"; also yjtD P 21%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): ilvI thiamine pyrophosphate-binding protein; leuB isocitrate/isopropylmalate family dehyd…; leuD 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase small sub…; thiB thiamine ABC transporter substrate-bind…; thiP ABC transporter permease subunit; araB ribulokinase; araA L-arabinose isomerase family protein; kefC glutathione-regulated potassium-efflux…; fixX ferredoxin family protein; fixC FAD-dependent oxidoreductase; fixB FAD-binding protein; caiA acyl-CoA dehydrogenase family protein; caiB L-carnitine CoA-transferase; caiC AMP-binding protein; caiD enoyl-CoA hydratase-related protein; caiE carnitine operon protein CaiE; caiF CaiF/GrlA family transcriptional regula…; thrC threonine synthase; thrB homoserine kinase; espY2 T3SS effector EspY2; espY1 T3SS effector EspY1; yjtD TrmH family RNA methyltransferase
END: the window ends at column 79, thrL, in 37% of chromosomes.
